files.purpose: Canonical schema DDL — copy of Sprint01_Core/10_schema.sql promoted to component root. Idempotent. Executed at startup by backend/database.py.
Python project manifest. Declares fastapi, uvicorn, psycopg2-binary, pydantic, httpx, pytest dependencies.
files.note: Mirror TaskTracker's pyproject.toml structure. Add pytest and httpx as dev dependencies.

files.purpose: Container image. Build context is repo root. Copies 02_Platform/packages to /platform_packages and sets PYTHONPATH. Copies backend/ and schema.sql. CMD: uvicorn backend.main:app.
Docker Compose service definition. Port 127.0.0.1:8022:8000. Environment: ATLAS_PG_* vars. Logs volume at ${DATA_ROOT}/storagetracker/logs. Joins atlas-net.
files.note: Port 8022 chosen to avoid collision with TaskTracker (8010), Notifications (8020), CalendarConnector (8021), and other Atlas services.

files.purpose: FastAPI app entry point. Installs CORS (allow_origin_regex localhost), exception handlers, request timing. Includes items router at prefix /api. On startup: init_pool(), init_schema().
key_details: Allowed methods: GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE

files.purpose: Connection pool management. Identical pattern to TaskTracker: _build_url() from ATLAS_PG_* or DATABASE_URL, SimpleConnectionPool(minconn=1, maxconn=5, RealDictCursor), get_db() context manager, init_schema() reads schema.sql relative to module path.
All item and history endpoints. Single router file.
key_details: Pydantic models: ItemCreate, ItemUpdate (all optional fields, uses model_fields_set), ItemState enum, ItemType enum
IMPORTANT: Register view routes BEFORE parameterised routes to avoid FastAPI routing conflict:
Auto-transition helper: _apply_auto_transition(quantity, min_quantity, caller_set_state) -> state | None
History helper: _record_history(conn, item_id, change_type, old_value, new_value, notes=None)
GET /items: filter validation, jsonb containment for source_tag (@> operator), returns Dataset
POST /items: validation, auto-transition, insert item, insert history (created), return Dataset
GET /items/views/*: direct SELECT queries, return Dataset
GET /items/{id}: fetch item + last 20 history, embed history list in row, return Dataset

PATCH /items/{id}: model_fields_set determines which fields to SET; auto-transition after quantity/min_quantity change if state not explicitly provided; record history per changed field; return Dataset
DELETE /items/{id}: DELETE RETURNING id; empty Dataset or 404
GET /items/{id}/history: confirm item exists, fetch all history DESC, return Dataset

files.purpose: React entry point registered with Atlas Shell. Provides routing and all UI views.
key_details: Components: AllItemsView, LowStockView, ImportantItemsView, RecyclingView, ItemDetailView, ItemFormModal
ItemFormModal used for both create and edit
item_type determines which optional fields render in form (quantity, min_quantity, source_tags for consumable)
State badge uses colour coding: stored=neutral, low_stock=warning, out_of_stock=error, marked_for_recycling=secondary, missing=error, lent_out=secondary
History timeline rendered in ItemDetailView as a simple ordered list

files.purpose: Shell registration config. Exports app name, icon, and route prefix for Atlas Shell discovery.
files.note: Mirror TaskTracker's shellConfig.ts. App name: 'StorageTracker', route prefix: '/items'.

files.content_summary: StorageTracker is a household item tracking application. Scope: Sprint 1 is core CRUD + history. Sprint 2 adds shopping tasks. Sprint 3 adds notifications. Follow TaskTracker patterns. Global rules in root CLAUDE.md.

migration_strategy: schema.sql executed idempotently at startup (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS). No Alembic in Sprint 1 — migrations/ directory reserved for Sprint 2+.
route_registration_warning: FastAPI evaluates routes in registration order. The four /api/items/views/* routes MUST be registered before /api/items/{id} and /api/items/{id}/history in items.py. Failure to do so causes FastAPI to match 'views' as the {id} path parameter.
test_notes: Backend tests use pytest + httpx ASGI transport against a test Postgres DB (or in-memory fixture). Minimum coverage: create item, list items, patch item (state auto-transition), delete item, history recording, view endpoints. See 10_test_spec.md for full spec.
